successors.name: House of Khalifa
successors.text: the islands of Bahrain and Zubarah, taken by the Bani Utbah in 1782-1783

ledger.x: 1753: the Al Madhkur of Bushehr take Bahrain.
17 May 1783: war between Nasr Al-Madhkur and the Bani Utbah.
28 July 1783: Al Madhkur rule ends and the Al Khalifa state begins.

wars.name: Bani Utbah conquest of Bahrain (1782-1783)
wars.outcome: Bani Utbah (Al Khalifa) victory: Nasr Al-Madhkur lost Bahrain; the conquest was 'completed on 28 July 1783'.

certainty.note: An island group: the archipelago itself is sharp, but its tie to the Zand (allegiance, 'in the name of Persia') is loose and undated at both ends.
